For example:

in the damage formula.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
Unfortunately the creator won't reply as
he passed away
but it should be a simple script call to add or subtract levels. I'll look at the plugin file later today.
Untested but
You could try
To check state count
$gameActors.actor(1).stateStack(x) or a.stateStack(x)
To subtract from the stack
$gameActors.actor(1)._stateTurns[stateId]-- or a._stateTurns[stateId]--
Also maybe to subtract 2 for example
$gameActors.actor(1)._stateTurns[stateId]-=2 or a._stateTurns[stateId]-=2
